integrity: Exact proofs and embedded standard-library checker; finite cases supplement but do not certify general theorem. Source publication verified by arXiv initial submission metadata. No independent scientific validation claimed.
scientific_limitations: Finite connected loopless simple undirected networks, strict shared preference bias 0<epsilon<1, binary immutable vertex preferences, asynchronous neighbor-copying. No claim at epsilon=0 or epsilon=1, on nonreversible networks, or of clinical or empirical calibration. One-step edge-type drift is already implicit in the motivating literature; the assessed contribution is the all-configurations exact equivalence with existence/uniqueness of linear opinion martingales and exact fixation consequences. Equivalent statements in broader voter literature might exist.
title: Exact neutrality criterion for finite partisan voter networks
